items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 11:59PM CST until November 16 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30
knots and rough waters.

* WHERE...Baffin Bay and Upper Laguna Madre, Corpus Christi and
Nueces Bays, Copano, Aransas, and Redfish Bays and San
Antonio, Mesquite, and Espiritu Santo Bays.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Occasional gusts to Gale Force remains
possible Monday.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 11:59PM CST until November 16 at 12:00AM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, southeast winds 15 to 25
knots and seas 5 to 8 feet. For the Gale Warning, northeast
winds 25 to 30 knots with gusts up to 40 knots and seas 8 to 13
feet expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas out 20
NM, Coastal waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
out 20 NM, Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas from 20 to
60 NM and Waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until midnight CST Sunday
night. For the Gale Warning, from midnight Sunday night to 6
PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Gale force winds may arrive earlier if the
front continues to trend faster.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
